title: Milos Training - Operations
description: TD-031 / ADR-116: traces, readiness, outbox, Oban, auth anomalies, cache, uploads.

panels.title: API scrape
panels.description: 1 = Prometheus can scrape the API's internal metrics listener.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts currently firing in Prometheus.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Server spans per second (traces, 5m window, probes excluded).

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of server requests answered with 5xx. Warning 2%, critical 5%.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: p95 server latency from traces. Warning 1s, critical 2.5s.

panels.title: Oldest outbox job
panels.description: Age of the oldest due-but-unexecuted Oban job across queues. Warning 5m, critical 15m.

panels.title: Request rate by route (top 10)
panels.description: Server request rate per route pattern.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Alert thresholds drawn at 2% and 5%.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Server latency percentiles from traces. Alert thresholds at 1s and 2.5s (p95).

panels.title: p95 latency by route (top 10, in-app histogram)
panels.description: Phoenix router_dispatch latency per route from the API's own exporter; works without tracing.

panels.title: 5xx by route (top 10)
panels.description: Which routes are failing.

panels.title: Router exceptions
panels.description: Requests that raised inside the router (5m increase).

panels.title: Dependency readiness
panels.description: Per-dependency result of the API readiness probe (every 30s). Critical after 2m down.

panels.title: Readiness failures (10m increase)
panels.description: Failed /api/health evaluations by failed dependency set. Warning above 5 in 10m.

panels.title: Oldest due outbox job by queue
panels.description: Healthy queues drain in seconds. Warning 5m, critical 15m.

panels.title: Outbox backlog by queue
panels.description: Due jobs waiting for first execution vs. waiting to retry. Retry warning above 20.

panels.title: Job failures by worker (15m increase)
panels.description: state=failure will retry; state=discard is terminal and alerts immediately.

panels.title: Job completions by queue
panels.description: Executions finishing without raising.

panels.title: Job duration p95 by queue
panels.description: Oban execution time.

panels.title: Auth anomalies by reason (10m increase)
panels.description: invalid_credentials > 50, invalid_refresh_token > 20, rate_limited > 10 per 10m alert. invalid_token/unauthenticated are mostly expired access tokens and are context only.

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections by bucket
panels.description: Requests rejected by rate limiting (10m increase).

panels.title: Cache operations by outcome
panels.description: Landing cache reads (hit/miss/error/unavailable) and invalidations (ok/error/unavailable).

panels.title: Upload rejections by reason (15m increase)
panels.description: Spike alert above 20 per 15m; storage-verification reasons alert above 3.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of landing reads served from Redis.

panels.title: BEAM memory
panels.description: Total BEAM memory.

panels.title: Run queue
panels.description: Scheduler run queue length; sustained values above the core count mean CPU saturation.

panels.title: Query time p95
panels.description: Ecto query time including pool queueing.

panels.title: Pool queue time p95
panels.description: Waiting for a database connection; rising values mean pool exhaustion.

panels.title: Collector spans
panels.description: Spans entering the collector. Refused/dropped spans mean trace-derived metrics undercount.

panels.title: Alert notifications
panels.description: Failed notifications usually mean ALERTMANAGER_WEBHOOK_URL is unset or wrong.
